name: synthetic-minds
description: Synthetic Minds - A multi-agent synthetic-world simulation and intelligence platform for modeling interactions between autonomous AI agents and exploring possible outcomes.

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:render: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && pip install -r requirements.txt
